color.note: Two lighting states, not two themes. `collapsed` is the void; `emitting` is the white hole. In the app the state is the `emitting` class on the root; here it is data-theme.

tokens.name: void
tokens.usage: The ground of the whole window: deep space, violet-tinted and never neutral black. Body text on it: `graphite` 15.75:1 collapsed, 16.27:1 emitting; `graphite-3` 5.97:1 and 6.44:1.

tokens.name: singularity
tokens.usage: The deepest tone of the void. Fills the accretion core's disk and the lamp's collapsed ground. Never a surface for text.

tokens.name: bench
tokens.usage: The bench: toolbar chrome, the drawer, the decision column, tooltips. Text on it: `graphite` 13.37:1 / 18.74:1, `graphite-2` 6.78:1 / 8.31:1, `graphite-3` 5.07:1 / 7.42:1 (collapsed / emitting).

tokens.name: raise
tokens.usage: One step above `bench`: hover, the open or selected tile, the needs-you tile, tooltips. About 4 L* per rung on the surface ladder.

tokens.name: sprocket
tokens.usage: Tile and film-strip ground, the edge strip. `graphite-2` on it: 7.38:1 collapsed, 5.74:1 emitting.

tokens.name: well
tokens.usage: The recessed ground under artwork (a tile's window, the matte toggle, the ledger bar). Artwork is judged on it, so never tint it.

tokens.name: graphite
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `void`, `bench`, `raise` and `sprocket`.

tokens.name: graphite-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: file names, control labels, ledger captions. On `bench` 6.78:1 collapsed, 8.31:1 emitting.

tokens.name: graphite-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: breadcrumbs, state words, film-strip headings. Floor is 5.07:1 on `bench` collapsed; never lighter than this.

tokens.name: score
tokens.usage: Hairlines and resting borders (a tile's inset ring, dividers, dashed control rules). A line, never text.

tokens.name: score-2
tokens.usage: Stronger borders: button outline, hovered tile ring, the value chip, the lamp's rim.

tokens.name: mark
tokens.usage: The strongest neutral line: the hovered lamp border and the accretion core's ring.

tokens.name: ruby
tokens.usage: Rubylith: this goes. The removal wash, the needs-you ring, a refused or blocked mark, and the one destructive colour. Same value in both states. As a mark on `void` it measures 4.54:1 collapsed and 3.65:1 emitting: carry a shape or word with it.

tokens.name: ruby-bg
tokens.usage: Quiet ground for a ruby message: the blocked banner, the removed segment of the ledger bar. Pair with `ruby-ink`.

tokens.name: ruby-ink
tokens.usage: Ruby as text: the needs-you word, the loss figure, the blocked banner word. On `ruby-bg` 6.64:1 collapsed, 5.74:1 emitting.

tokens.name: cyan
tokens.usage: This stays: the cut line, the selected tile, focus in the collapsed state, the primary fill. Emitting needs its own value because #22d3ee measures 1.81:1 on white. As a mark on `void`: 10.54:1 collapsed, 4.06:1 emitting.

tokens.name: cyan-bg
tokens.usage: Quiet ground for a cyan message: the `auto` chip, the kept segment of the ledger bar. Pair with `cyan-ink`.

tokens.name: cyan-ink
tokens.usage: Cyan as text, on `cyan-bg`: 9.47:1 collapsed, 5.32:1 emitting.

tokens.name: go-ink
tokens.usage: Text on a `cyan` fill (the primary button). 9.25:1 collapsed, 4.67:1 emitting; it flips with the lighting state.

tokens.name: qregion-ink
tokens.usage: The disputed region's own label, set ON `ruby`. 4.64:1.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: A status MARK only (the done tick, the safe ledger figure), never a surface. 7.68:1 and 5.87:1 on `bench`.

tokens.name: ok-bg
tokens.usage: Reserved quiet ground for an ok message; no shipped surface paints it yet.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: A status MARK only: not checked, confirm, conflict, a blank ledger. Never a surface. 8.14:1 and 6.72:1 on `bench`.

tokens.name: amber-bg
tokens.usage: The confirm banner's ground. Pair with `amber` text.

tokens.name: horizon
tokens.usage: The accretion disk's warm edge: the lighting toggle's rim and the empty table's horizon. Decoration, not text.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 2px focus ring. Cyan on the void; an ink ring on the light ground, where cyan failed 3:1 (1.40 to 1.81). 14.95:1 on `void` emitting.

tokens.name: star
tokens.usage: A star in the field, and the crisp ring on the lamp's collapsed cut. Inverts to a dark mote in the light state so both carry the same grain.

tokens.name: star-cold
tokens.usage: The cooler star tint for the field's second tile.

tokens.name: neb-violet
tokens.usage: The off-centre violet bloom behind the table, and the stage's vignette edge. It must stay transparent at the centre: lensing never reaches artwork.

tokens.name: neb-blue
tokens.usage: The cold blue bloom, top right of the table.

tokens.name: chk-a
tokens.usage: Alpha checkerboard, cell A. Notation for 'something transparent is here'; quiet on purpose.

tokens.name: chk-b
tokens.usage: Alpha checkerboard, cell B. Absent only from the empty table, where nothing transparent is shown.

tokens.name: sw-chroma
tokens.usage: The chroma swatch AT REST, deliberately muted so a verification control never out-shouts the artwork.

tokens.name: sw-chroma-live
tokens.usage: The real key green, shown on hover, when chosen, and as the ground when matte is chroma.

tokens.name: ring-inner
tokens.usage: Inner tone of the two-tone selection ring, used where a ground can be white, black, a checker or chroma.

tokens.name: ring-outer
tokens.usage: Outer tone of the two-tone ring: whichever tone the ground swallows, the other still shows.

tokens.name: lit-1
tokens.usage: The lamp's lit side, start of the gradient.

tokens.name: lit-2
tokens.usage: The lamp's lit side, middle stop.

tokens.name: lit-3
tokens.usage: The lamp's lit side, end stop.

tokens.name: rim-core
tokens.usage: Centre of the lamp's travelling rim: a hot accretion edge.

tokens.name: rim-mid
tokens.usage: The rim's warm shoulder.

tokens.name: rim-edge
tokens.usage: The rim's transparent end, so it feathers into both grounds.

tokens.name: bloom
tokens.usage: The emitting state's bloom, a white hole giving light back.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: The ledger's removed-pixel count: the first number worth looking at.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: The open asset's name. The code sets font-stretch: 104% on it.

styles.name: h3
styles.sample: Is the hatched area part of the picture?

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Drop files to cut their background.
styles.usage: Body copy and drawer headings (drawer headings at 600).

styles.name: mono-meta
styles.usage: Breadcrumbs, film-strip headings, ledger text: anything that reports an instrument reading.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: File names under tiles, state words, tags and chips (chips take weight 500). 11px is the floor for anything functional.

spacing.note: Five steps. Nothing in the shipped CSS sits between them.

tokens.name: s1
tokens.usage: Tight gaps: inside a tile's caption, the film strip, between stacked list items.

tokens.name: s2
tokens.usage: Default control gap and tile padding.

tokens.name: s3
tokens.usage: Section padding, the grid gap on the contact sheet.

tokens.name: s4
tokens.usage: Page gutters.

tokens.name: s5
tokens.usage: Large breaks, and the square drawer-close target.

radius.note: Two small steps, not four: the shipped scale once ran 3, 4, 5, 6, 8 and 12px.

tokens.name: r-xs
tokens.usage: Focus ring corners, the cut line's blade handle, the ledger bar.

tokens.name: r-sm
tokens.usage: Lamp, swatches, small controls, the region label.

tokens.name: r
tokens.usage: Buttons, tab buttons, tile windows, inputs, drawers' popovers.

tokens.name: r2
tokens.usage: Tiles (the contact-sheet frame) and the wipe.

tokens.name: r-pill
tokens.usage: Chips and tags (`auto`, the wipe tags). Written as a literal in the code.

shadow.note: Borders on the void, shadows only on things that float.

tokens.name: float
tokens.usage: The drawer and tab tooltips: the only elements that float.
